summary_en: Final dividend for FY2026/6 increased ¥5/share to ¥30/share; annual dividend raised to ¥55/share from ¥50/share. Prior year comparator: ¥50 annual (¥25 mid-term, ¥25 final).
title_en: Notice of Revision to Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending June 2026
translation_en_brief: Alpen Co., Ltd. announced on 10 June 2026 that its Board of Directors resolved to raise the dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending 30 June 2026. The year-end dividend per share will be increased by ¥5 to ¥30/share. Combined with the interim dividend of ¥25/share (paid in the second quarter), the total annual dividend rises to ¥55/share, compared to the previously forecast ¥50/share (¥25 mid-term + ¥25 final). The prior fiscal year (ended June 2025) also paid ¥50 annual (¥25 mid-term + ¥25 final). The company stated that the increase reflects comprehensive assessment of progress in full-year earnings and forward-looking business conditions, consistent with its basic policy of stable and continuous profit returns to shareholders while strengthening financial position and building retained earnings for future business development.
